reason: Ten interface-core defects and one Core/UI stream regression, all UI-only. (1) streamChat mapped every HTTP 5xx that Core returned before accepting a new message to the generic 'lost before acceptance' text, discarding the real detail and error_id; a received response is now treated as definitive and the ApiError is rethrown. (2) request() logged every aborted fetch (project switch, view unmount, the 5 s health deadline) as an error-level interface.api.transport_failed record; cancellations are now a debug interface.api.request_cancelled record with outcome cancelled. (3) resolveApproval removed the approval card locally while Core was offline or starting without deciding anything; it now throws 'Nebula Core must be online to decide an approval.' so the callers' existing catch paths surface it and the card stays. (4) listLibraryItems fetched one unpaged /library/items call (server default 100) and now pages through listAll like every sibling list. (5) The 45 s header timer on the initial chat POST fired while Core was still inside prepare_async (retrieval planning, compaction, route verification, each a model call) before answering with headers; the acceptance budget is now 15 minutes (the longest provider timeout) while a reconnect GET keeps 45 s. (6) The diagnostics fallback queue retained every error-level record unbounded; it now keeps the newest 1000 including one interface.diagnostics.records_dropped notice carrying dropped_count. (7) The diagnostics ZIP export revoked its object URL synchronously after click(); it is deferred like the other download sites. (8) A stale link to an archived project cleared the remembered project from storage and the boundary offered no link because engagement was undefined; the remembered id is kept unless that project itself is gone, and the boundary offers the remembered (or first active) project as the way back. (9) ThemeContext and WorkspaceContext read/wrote localStorage unguarded in their useState initializers and mutators, so blocked site data crashed the first render; a browserStorage helper wraps every access. (10) persistSelectionHandoff navigated the chat/notes/terminal handoffs unconditionally after the awaited createHandoff, pulling the operator back to the Workbench after they moved on; it now attaches the handoff only while the location is still that Workbench view. (Regression) Core's terminal cancelled frame (#406) was never consumed: the wire union, processBlock and applyChatEvent now handle it so a follower of a stopped turn ends cleanly with the assistant bubble in state cancelled with elapsed time instead of eight reconnect attempts and an error banner. Frontend proof: client.test.ts (503-before-acceptance rethrows the ApiError with status and errorId; aborted health call logs no error record while a real transport failure still does; Library paging issues limit=1000/offset=1000; a hanging POST is still pending after 60 s and fails as lost-before-acceptance after 16 min; a followed turn ending in a cancelled frame resolves undefined with a cancelled event and no reconnect), logger.test.ts (1050 errors retain at most 1000 with the newest last and a dropped_count notice), DiagnosticsPanel.test.tsx (revoke not called during click, called afterwards), WorkspaceContext.recovery.test.tsx (approval card kept and decideApproval not called offline; remembered project kept for an archived-project URL; bootstrap succeeds with Storage throwing SecurityError), ThemeContext.test.tsx (default appearance with storage blocked), App.projectBoundary.test.tsx (Project unavailable offers Open Current project and storage keeps current), WorkbenchDraftContext.navigation.test.tsx (note handoff attaches while still on the Workbench; Take note and Add to context do not navigate back after moving to /settings), chatMessageReconciliation.test.ts (cancelStreamingAssistantMessage settles the bubble as cancelled with elapsedMs and partial content). All 15 new tests fail on origin/main and pass here; chatConnection.test.ts, WorkbenchDraftContext.test.ts and chatStreamLifecycle.test.ts are the neighbouring seams and pass unchanged.
exclusions: No Python tests: no Core file changed (the Core cancelled frame producer is already covered by test_chat_api.py on main). No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. Playwright: ui/src/state/** and ui/src/App.tsx are full patterns, so this is an explicit selection. area:assistant (mock and real-core chat journeys) covers the chat page consuming the changed stream client; area:chat-reconnection and area:durable-conversation-core drive streamChat's follow/reconnect path on real Core, where the per-attempt header budget and the cancelled frame live; area:critical-workspaces renders every route at desktop and narrow widths through the changed WorkspaceContext bootstrap, ThemeContext initializer and App project boundary; area:themes and area:appearance-settings cover the theme preference path now routed through browserStorage; area:workbench-view-authority covers the assistant context handoff navigation changed in WorkbenchDraftContext; area:stabilization covers the pending-approval restore and review flows that call resolveApproval. Excluded: area:chat-edit-in-place and area:provider-thinking (assistant-rule siblings) never stop a turn, so the only SessionsPage change (the cancelled branch) is unreachable in them; area:desktop-interface and area:mobile-layout are the grep-less fallback runs matched only by chatMessageReconciliation.ts, a pure helper proven by its vitest; area:project-lifecycle exercises the host folder picker, not the stale-link boundary, which App.projectBoundary.test.tsx proves directly; area:ask-nebula-popup, area:assistant-viewer and area:assistant-reliability do not reach persistSelectionHandoff's navigation or the approval mutator. No Playwright area exists for diagnostics or the Library list; their vitest files are the proof. The known App.test.tsx failure 'keeps diagnostics out of the advanced view while preserving legacy hashes' reproduces on main only when the whole file runs and is the sole failure there with this change (38 of 39 pass), so App.test.tsx is not selected. No full suites.
